🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: extreme narrow sector leadership (Top 5: AMD, INTC, QCOM, META = 4/5 Technology) and MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (multiple big names with 1W ≠ 1M), supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows pockets of strength led by AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -17.86%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -11.72% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -17.86%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select tech and healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +13.15%), INTC (1W: +12.29%), QCOM (1W: +7.95%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE (≥3 large caps with conflicting 1W vs 1M: MSFT, AMAT, ETN, TXN, NOW) — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with narrow leadership and many short-term recoveries; NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -16.63%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: -0.21% (24 stocks) and showing internal rotation rather than broad risk-on.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft near-term; JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION — breadth weak and no clear cyclical bid.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Under pressure: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -8.44%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION — defensive bid absent and sector lagging.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Neutral stance: favor selective Energy and proven Tech winners (VLO ABOVE TREND, AMD ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging healthcare and discretionary names (NVS, AMGN, BKNG showing sustained weakness). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak breadth.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +8.60%) Sector Strength within the current universe. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -5.60% | 1M: -2.76%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -7.00%) — watch for continued downside.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AMD for follow-through above this week’s highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; monitor AAPL holding its 1M gains as support; NVDA failing to reclaim recent levels would keep it BELOW TREND and risk broader tech pullback.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (+75): Adobe headline lifting guidance vs price ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price diverging (distribution). SHOP (+50): upbeat analyst note vs SHOP (1W: -11.72% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND — sentiment not yet confirming price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMGN (-50): negative trial headline and AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. PFE (-45): contentious headline while PFE (1W: -3.78% | 1M: +5.36%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through (divergence between news and price).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA BELOW TREND) and mixed headlines (ADBE both +75 and -50) — monitor for confirmed breadth expansion.
